subject: Request: Short runway support while PO completes - Clarion Health pilot
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@clarionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement is delayed, request for short runway help

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from procurement — our PO is caught up in an internal approvals queue and looks like it won't clear until early next week. We're in the middle of the Clarion Health integration pilot and will lose a chunk of momentum if the sandbox and token access lapse.

Is there any way Redwood can top up our pilot with a short run of credits or keep the environment live for ~7 days while the PO clears? We'll share the PO reference the moment it's signed (procurement@clarionhealth.com is cc'd).

Attached: Clarion_PO_status.xlsx (export from our procurement system)

Appreciate any flexibility — Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Head of Digital Transformation, Clarion Health
A: alicia@clarionhealth.com | M: +1-415-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 17:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement is delayed, request for short runway help

Thanks for the context Alicia — really appreciate the heads up and the PO status sheet.

Short answer: yes, we can help keep Clarion's pilot environment live while procurement finishes. I can provision a 7-day credit bundle and keep the sandbox endpoints pinned to the same model/version so your engineers don't hit warm-up latency.

Two quick asks so I can move this today:
- Confirm which workspace the team is using (team slug or primary admin email).
- Confirm whether you want the credits applied to the current sandbox only or to both sandbox + shared test seats.

I'm looping in Ben (finance) to confirm we can approve a one-off top-up and Dev (legal) for any notes in the event the PO changes terms. Once Ben confirms, I'll send a voucher PDF and a short usage note.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1-650-555-0122

Ben / Dev — forwarding a request from Clarion Health. They are mid-pilot and procurement expects a PO will be signed next week, but the approvals queue may close Thursday or Friday.

Proposal: finance provides a one-off 7-day voucher (small credit amount tied to current pilot usage) and we mark the workspace to auto-reinstate access only when the PO arrives. If procurement pulls the PO we reconcile against the final invoice — nothing open-ended.

Key details:
- Account: Clarion Health (deal CLAR-2027-01)
- Workspace admin: Alicia Moreno
- Attachments from customer: Clarion_PO_status.xlsx, pilot-usage-report.csv

Please advise if we need legal language in the voucher or any accounting code. If approved, I'll generate the voucher PDF and send a short usage guidance note to Alicia.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — this is great, thank you. Procurement confirmed they expect the PO signed by Wednesday EOD but wanted us to secure continued access to avoid losing development time. Please go ahead with the 7-day voucher applied to our sandbox only.

I've attached a quick export that shows current API call volumes (pilot-usage-report.csv). If you need the PO reference sooner I'll push procurement to expedite, but the team can continue testing with the short top-up.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Alicia
